subject: Error initialising packrat in Rstudio: incomplete block on file

messages.author: e89d8110f6b1c915
messages.subject: Error initialising packrat in Rstudio: incomplete block on file
parts:
I'm having trouble getting Packrat set up on a new or existing project in Rstudio V0.98.1028. 

Error message: Fetching sources for packrat (0.4.0.12) ... Error in snapshotSources(project, activeRepos(project), allRecordsFlat) : 
  Errors occurred when fetching source files:
Error in untar2(tarfile, files, list, exdir, restore_times) :  incomplete block on file

I would appreciate any tips to overcome this. 

Thanks, 
Amy
